package com.egradx.events
  • Related Packages

    Description

  • Class
    Description
    EgradxEvent
    One event, as CloudEvents 1.0 has it (https://cloudevents.io), and as every EGRADX SDK writes it on every transport: structured JSON, application/cloudevents+json.
    EgradxEventDispatcher
    Hands each event to the application's handlers of its type.
    EgradxEventHandler
    Handles one type of event.
    EgradxEventLogSink
    Ships log lines as "egradx.log.record.v1" events, straight through the transport: not through the outbox, because log volume would swamp a table, and a lost line is not a lost change.
    EgradxEventPublisher
    Publishes events.
    EgradxEventRelay
    Takes events from the outbox and sends them through the transport.
    EgradxEventRelay.Settings
    How the relay behaves; see egradx.events.relay.*.
    EgradxEventTransport
    How events travel: within this process (the default), over RabbitMQ, or over Kafka.
    EgradxInProcessEventTransport
    Events within this process: the relay hands each event straight to this application's handlers.
    EgradxOutboxEventPublisher
    Publishes into egradx_event_outbox, through the application's JDBC connection, so the row joins whatever transaction the caller is in.
